Maya: Found this sticky note on the kitchen cabinet. 100% sure the coffee machine has started a side hustle as a critique bot.

Maya: ```
Model (kitchen-agent v1.2): I heated your croissant using greedy decoding. Next time, consider `temperature=0.7` if you want nuance. — Fridge
```

Devin: :joy: it literally signed it '— Fridge'? amazing.

Ravi: @Devin please don't give the toaster access keys :grimacing:

Jordan: We should add an onboarding prompt: "Be supportive but brutally honest."

Linda: Passive-aggressive appliances are peak 2026 culture :coffee: :stuck_out_tongue: 

Ops-bot: kitchen-agent v1.2 deployed to cluster-kitchen-01 at 1774920020

Maya: Here's the prompt I used last night: ```Make my pastry warm and roast my life choices softly```

Devin: Now we need a 'compliment' mode and a 'roast' mode toggle.

Ravi: Also a 'leave it on the counter' fallback so it doesn't overheat the bagels.

Jordan: Can we get it to leave debugging hints instead of snark? `try unplugging` :sweat_smile: 

Linda: Tiny SLA for the toaster: no unsolicited life coaching between 9–11am.

Maya: Agreed. Photo attached (meme reaction). Will not share keys with the microwave :zipper_mouth_face:
